_comment: Repo-tracked CURATED catalog for Higgs Audio v3 narration voices — the Higgs counterpart of orpheus-models.json, and deliberately NOT the same shape where the two engines differ. Orpheus's catalog OVERLAYS a per-machine runtime install manifest because Orpheus voices are folder-discovered. Higgs has no folder discovery: a Higgs voice is a row in THIS FILE, so there is no runtime manifest and no reconcile fallback — a voice that is not listed here does not exist, and higgs-models.ts refuses it BY NAME rather than falling through to the served model's own speaker (which measures at 12% of the narrator's ECAPA ceiling: a DIFFERENT person, not a weak clone). Every number in backends.served is MEASURED — provenance in E:\training\_campaigns\2026-09-01-cod-full-rebuild\higgs\HIGGS_V3_LEVERS.md — or is an explicitly-marked placeholder that the loader REFUSES to render with.
_wireFormatComment: THIS FILE IS NOT THE WIRE FORMAT. narrator reads a VOICE DOCUMENT whose path arrives in NARRATOR_HIGGS_VOICES (see python/narrator/engine/higgs/config.py load_voices): `{ "<voiceId>": { "clips": [{path, transcript, seconds}], "scene"?, "adapterDir"?, "allowedControls"?, "maxReferenceSeconds"? } }`. In THAT format a Higgs voice is ALWAYS clips, and a fine-tune is an `adapterDir` riding on the same object — there is no separate adapter kind. This catalog keeps an explicit `kind` anyway, because `kind` is what selects BOOKFORGE'S OWN RULES (above all: maxChars is REQUIRED and measured for an adapter, and may be the engine placeholder for a zero-shot voice) and because a picker has to tell a person which of the two they are choosing. `higgsVoicesDocument()` in higgs-models.ts translates one into the other; it is the only place the two shapes meet.
_licenseComment: Higgs Audio v3 (bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b) ships under the Boson Higgs TTS 3 RESEARCH AND NON-COMMERCIAL license, and a fine-tune of those weights INHERITS it. That is why every entry carries an explicit `license` and `commercialUse: false`: this engine is enabled for Owen's personal evaluation and cannot ship in a commercial BookForge build without a separate licence from Boson AI. Higgs Audio v2 is the trainable-and-shippable family (Community licence: attribution plus 'Higgs Audio 2' in any fine-tune's name) and is NOT in this catalog — Owen dropped v2 on 2026-09-04 ('basically just Orpheus and we know Orpheus better').
_referenceComment: EXACTLY ONE REFERENCE CLIP PER VOICE, 30 s of audio at the very most. vllm-omni refuses multi-shot cloning, so 'two clips' means ONE pre-joined wav (clips joined by 0.35 s of silence) whose transcript is the transcripts joined in the same order — the joining happens when the voice is STAGED, never at render time, and this catalog stores the joined result. Every clip must declare its `seconds`: narrator's v3_served.reference_seconds refuses a clip without one rather than probing the file, so a missing duration is a render that dies after the server has already spent five minutes coming up. Measured: no reference 0.093 speaker cosine, one clip 0.680, two joined 0.692, against a 0.766 narrator self-ceiling — and same-book-vs-cross-book is worth +0.076 where the second clip is worth only +0.012, so a reference set must come from ONE book.

serving._comment: The shared v3 serving stack, selected by a model's engineVersion. A model entry may declare its own `serving` block, used INSTEAD of this one (never field-merged) so a voice has exactly one serving answer. narrator INVOKES the operator's launch script rather than writing its own — the CUDA_HOME/FlashInfer workarounds live there and a second copy would drift — so `launchScript` is what NARRATOR_HIGGS3_SERVE_SCRIPT points at.
serving._coldStartNote: 297 s from launch to /health answering, MEASURED on narrator's own GPU smoke (2026-09-04) — not the ~55 s the first audition reported, which was a warm cache. narrator's READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 300, i.e. the measurement sits three seconds under the limit. Anything in BookForge that decides a Higgs job is dead must therefore allow AT LEAST five minutes before the first audio. Checked against the two that could: WORKER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS is 10 minutes and WORKER_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT_MS is 12 (parallel-tts-bridge.ts), so both already clear it — but they clear it by minutes, not by an order of magnitude, and anyone tightening them must re-read this line. The server also preallocates to its utilization target (0.60 of 24 GB), so it OWNS the GPU while it is up.
serving._flashInferNote: FlashInfer is unavailable on sm_86 with torch 2.13+cu130 — it JIT-builds its attention kernels with nvcc and its bundled CCCL headers reject the CUDA 13 nvcc from the pip wheel — so the launch pins VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0, VLLM_DISABLE_FLASHINFER_PREFILL=1 and --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN. Speed only; the flashinfer-jit-cache cu130/sm_86 wheel from https://flashinfer.ai/whl/cu130/torch2.13/ is the route if v3 speed ever matters.
serving._adapterStrategyNote: NARRATOR_HIGGS3_ADAPTER_STRATEGY, and BOTH STRATEGIES REQUIRE A SERVER RESTART — there is no per-request adapter path on this stack. 'lora-modules' adds `--enable-lora --lora-modules <name>=<path>` to the launch; 'merged-dir' makes the path REPLACE the served model argument. WHICH ONE vllm-omni ACTUALLY ACCEPTS FOR higgs_multimodal_qwen3 HAS NOT BEEN EXERCISED, which is why no voice here declares one yet: narrator refuses to guess, and it is right to — the wrong strategy is a server that comes up serving the BASE voice and renders an entire book in it while reporting success.

patches.why: vLLM 0.28's blanket negative-token-id rejection fires on vllm-omni's AUDIO_PLACEHOLDER_ID (-100), which the clone path deliberately emits for the talker to substitute reference embeddings at prefill. Without the patch EVERY clone request is HTTP 400 'Token id -100 is out of vocabulary' — which is what made cloning look broken in the first audition.

vllm-omni substitutes the ramp-down BOC/EOC sentinels with codec code 0 (a VALID code that decodes to real sound) and then trims exactly ONE frame, leaving ~240 ms of audible garbage at the end of every chunk — Owen heard it as 'a stray syllable or sound after each sentence'. The patch drops the trailing sentinel run BY CONTENT, which cannot eat real speech. Terminal burst peak measured 12-20 dB quieter after it. IT IS SERVER-SIDE: a patched server returns an already-clean tail and THE CLIENT MUST NOT TRIM AGAIN — what is left is a hard sample boundary, which is the assembler's 10/25 ms fade job.

models.label: Higgs v3 default (zero-shot)

served._maxCharsNote: 600 is the ZERO-SHOT figure and it is measured, not guessed: coverage by faster-whisper/difflib alignment is 1.000 at 213/440/504 chars and holds through 600, while 898 chars fails REPRODUCIBLY (coverage 0.86 and 0.78 on two seeds; tail coverage 0.314 and 0.000 — it drops the end of the paragraph). A reference clip does NOT fix it; it is a v3 model property that v2 does not have. DURATION RATIO IS NOT A COVERAGE PROXY: at temperature 0.7 the 898-char chunk produced ratio 0.99 while actually delivering coverage 0.778 with a 26% insert rate — it dropped text and padded the duration with hallucinated words, and any cap built on duration alone would have passed it. THIS NUMBER IS VALID ONLY FOR ZERO-SHOT and must never be copied onto an adapter voice; see the deathstalker entry.
served._edgeFadeNote: WHO APPLIES THIS: narrator's assembler, and as of 2026-09-05 NOBODY DOES YET — Owen assigned it there (the manifest carries pads=false plus edge_fade_ms and the assembler fades each chunk edge), and until that lands a Higgs book joins at hard sample boundaries and clicks. The number is recorded here because it is MEASURED and because the catalog is where per-voice tuning lives, not because this side applies it: an earlier draft of parallel-tts-bridge.ts justified routing Higgs assembly to narrator by claiming narrator already read this field, which was false on both sides. WHY THE FADE IS NEEDED AT ALL: Higgs emits NO lead/trail silence of its own — unlike Orpheus, which bakes pads into each chunk FLAC — and the patched server already trims its own sentinel tail, so what reaches the assembler ends at a hard sample boundary: a step discontinuity, i.e. a click. 25 ms cosine out / 10 ms in removes it, taking a chunk edge from about -30 dB to -45..-48 dB. It is applied at ASSEMBLY and never baked into the per-chunk wav, so the raw model output stays inspectable. This is also why the manifest gapBefore/gapAfter become LIVE for Higgs where they are inert for Orpheus.
served._samplingNote: The server's OWN shipped defaults (vllm_omni/deploy/higgs_multimodal_qwen3.yaml, stage 0 default_sampling_params), and the delivered render sends NO extra_params at all so they apply verbatim. Written down here anyway so the value that renders is stated rather than inherited invisibly from a yaml inside site-packages. TWO TRAPS: (1) temperature/top_p/top_k are NOT fields of OpenAICreateSpeechRequest — sent at the request top level pydantic DROPS them silently and the render runs at 1.0/0.95/50 regardless, which is exactly how the first audition reported 0.3 while running at 1.0; they must ride inside `extra_params`. (2) Deviations were measured (temp 0.3/0.7/1.0 at top_p 0.95 gave cosine 0.653/0.675/0.642 at 368 chars) and the spread is INSIDE single-seed noise — two seeds of the same setting differ by 0.04 — so one seed per cell cannot rank them and none beat the default enough to leave it.
served._allowedControlsNote: EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and it is a safety rule rather than a preference. An inline control token that is NOT in get_added_vocab() is split into 7-10 ordinary text pieces and READ ALOUD, which derails generation into a degenerate loop: ASR coverage 0.000, pitch std collapsing to 0.28 st, speaker cosine 0.05. A typo is not ignored — it destroys the render. v3 also has NO scene-description mechanism (<|scene_desc_start|> is a v2 chat role, absent from v3's vocabulary) and no `neutral`/`calm` emotion. At default sampling no control token beat plain text on speaker cosine, and the one candidate (<|prosody:long_pause|>) did not change measured pause density. The delivered render uses none. An empty allowlist means no engine ever has to get the validation right.

models.note: The model's own voice with no reference audio at all. MEASURED at ECAPA speaker cosine 0.0929 against the deathstalker narrator — 12% of that narrator's own 0.7656 self-consistency ceiling — i.e. it is a DIFFERENT SPEAKER, not a weak clone. It is listed because it is the one Higgs voice that needs nothing staged on disk, so it is what a machine can audition the serving stack with before any clone or fine-tune exists. Do not narrate a book in it expecting a particular narrator.

models.label: Deathstalker (Higgs v3 fine-tune)
models._pendingNote: NOT INSTALLED, NOT MEASURED, AND REFUSED BY THE LOADER UNTIL BOTH ARE DONE. The adapter path above is a documented PLACEHOLDER stating the convention (WSL-native /home/<user>/higgs-models/<voice>, mirroring the Orpheus models dir); nothing is installed at it. What exists on 2026-09-04 is a QUICK 300-step r32 LoRA at /mnt/e/training/_campaigns/2026-09-01-cod-full-rebuild/higgs/v3_ft/runs/quick30_r32/final, trained by the orpheus-training session against a from-scratch v3 module (v3 ships no training code); the full 12.4 h ds_ad4 corpus run has NOT been started. THREE THINGS BLOCK PROMOTION: (1) the artifact must be staged at the path above; (2) `maxChars` must be MEASURED by a length sweep on this adapter — see _maxCharsNote, it is null on purpose and the loader refuses the voice while it is; (3) NARRATOR_HIGGS3_ADAPTER_STRATEGY must be established, because how vllm-omni loads a LoRA for higgs_multimodal_qwen3 has never been exercised — the fine-tune was rendered through the trainer's own generate_audio, never through the served stack. The narration dropdown SHOWS this voice, greyed, carrying this note: a voice everyone is waiting for should not silently be absent from the list.

served._maxCharsNote: NULL, AND THE LOADER REFUSES THIS VOICE BECAUSE OF IT. A fine-tuned Higgs adapter's stop length tracks its TRAINING CLIP LENGTH, not the length of the text it is given: the training side measured a 30-minute adapter trained on 8-22 s clips stopping after ~6-10 s of audio on ANY prompt over ~150 characters. So the zero-shot 600 is not merely imprecise for an adapter, it is WRONG BY A FACTOR OF FOUR IN THE WRONG DIRECTION — a book packed at 600 would lose most of every chunk while every duration check looked plausible. The real number comes from THIS model's own length sweep, verified by ASR alignment and never by duration ratio, and it lands beside a `maxCharsSource` recording the method. For a ds_ad4l cut trained on clips up to ~100 s that projects to roughly 1,200-1,500 — but projection is not measurement, which is the whole reason this field is null rather than a guess.

models.note: The deathstalker narrator as a v3 LoRA. WHY AN ADAPTER RATHER THAN REFERENCE CLIPS: zero-shot cloning already recovers 92% of the narrator's speaker-identity ceiling (cosine 0.7037 of 0.7656, from a 27.4 s two-clip same-book reference), so TIMBRE is largely solved without any training. What cloning does NOT recover is PHRASING — the render places 2.01 pauses per 100 chars against the narrator's 1.39 and runs pitch std 5.17 st against his 4.36, i.e. it performs the text rather than reading it, and no reference, sampling setting or control token moved either number. Only a fine-tune on his phrasing closes that gap, which is what this entry is for.
models._cloneFallbackNote: There is deliberately no clips-based deathstalker entry standing in for this one. The measured best zero-shot configuration is a 27.4 s join of cd_cd_00001100.wav + cd_cd_00001951.wav from the ds_ad4s cut with their book-exact transcripts, and it renders well — but those clips live under E:\training and are not a deployable artifact location, so an entry pointing at them would be a voice that works on exactly one machine, which is the failure this catalog exists to prevent. To add one: join the clips to a single wav (0.35 s of silence between them), join the transcripts in the same order, stage both under /home/<user>/higgs-models/<voice>/refs/, and declare ONE clip here with its measured `seconds`.
